column4: Perlina is the lone "-ina" name in the whole file; house style pairs a duplicate-avoiding second name with "-ín" (Lodín, Burbujín, Honguín, Estrellín, Marín, Platín, Frijolín, Piedrín...). Perlín keeps the bead/pearl sense of 珠 without duplicating n064 Perlita and matches that pattern.

Chorrito means a little trickle/squirt of liquid, not a drop, so it drifts from the verified English "Droplet" (滴 = drop). Gotita is taken by n119, but Gotín keeps the drop meaning intact and follows the same duplicate-avoiding "-ín" pattern used throughout the file, unused elsewhere.
